title: Invention Secrecy Act burying inventions
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Invention Secrecy Act burying inventions, about 1951 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And let's not forget about the Invention Secrecy Act of 1951.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels, who interviews guests about UFOs and government secrecy, points to the Invention Secrecy Act of 1951, a US law that lets the government order some patent applications kept secret. He brings it up as a reminder that, in his framing, the government has the power to bury inventions, which if true would mean some technology is kept out of public view.
